text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
SummerOlympic(x) ::: x is the summer Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
WonMedals(x, y, z) ::: x won y medals in z.
LastEvent(x) ::: x is the last event.
Premises:
SummerOlympic(summerOlympic) ∧ SportingEvent(summerOlympic) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastEvent(tokyo) ∧ Location(summerOlympic, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMedals(unitedStates, mostMedals, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
WonMedals(unitedStates, mostMedals, summerOlympic) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
